items.title: Franck Avitabile Trio and nature-inspired algorithms
items.summary: A Michel Petrucciani tribute at Le Melville tonight and a free Sunday Maison Paris Nature talk on bio-inspired algorithmic trade-offs.

items.title: View Dropout for causal visual thinking and GenCeption video-generation pretraining
items.summary: VDrop withholds visual evidence from answer tokens to force use of generated visual scratchpads; GenCeption reuses a pretrained video diffusion backbone for text-steered perception tasks.

items.title: Zippers for immutable data structures
items.summary: A zipper pairs a focused subtree with a one-hole context, supporting local navigation and edits without mutating the original recursive structure.

items.title: Room-temperature phonon focusing in cubic boron arsenide
items.summary: Nanoscale temperature mapping and Boltzmann-transport simulations reveal crystal-directed ray-like heat patterns at room temperature.

items.title: Turkey's New Party and EU circumvention-network sanctions
items.summary: Özgür Özel and 91 lawmakers form a new parliamentary bloc after the CHP leadership ruling; the EU's 21st Russia package increasingly targets third-country ships, banks, intermediaries and crypto platforms.

items.title: France's July PMI is near stabilization, not recovery
items.summary: The composite PMI rose from 47.2 to 49.6, with services at 49.8 and manufacturing output at 50.0; contraction eased but growth has not been established.

items.title: Marx on production relations as the hidden basis of social structure
items.summary: The passage links forms of surplus extraction to relations of sovereignty, dependence and the corresponding form of the state.

items.title: Paine on normalized error; La Boétie on withdrawn support
items.summary: Paine examines how custom makes contingency appear legitimate; La Boétie treats domination as dependent on distributed compliance while raising the problem of costly coordination.

items.title: ça se tente
items.summary: An informal way to say an uncertain option is worth trying, distinct from ça te tente.

items.title: The Vasa's polyethylene-glycol conservation
items.summary: Seventeen years of PEG spray treatment and nine years of controlled drying replaced structural water inside the waterlogged warship's timber.

items.title: Sleeping Beauty problem
